full_judgment:
Syed Md. Ziaul Karim, J: This Rule, calls in question the legality and propriety of judgment and order dated 31-05-2000 passed by learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Gazipur, allowing Misc. Case no. 40 of 1998 filed under Order IX Rule 13 and section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure (briefly as Code). 

 4. The trial Court by the judgment and decree dated 21-06-1998 decreed the suit on contest. Then on 21-10-1998 the defendants as petitioners instituted Misc. Case no. 40 of 1998 under Order IX Rule 13 and section 151 of the Code for setting aside the decree passed in Title Suit no. 97 of 1995. The trial Court allowed the same. Hence the rule. 

 5. Mr. J.K. Paul, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners seeks to impeach the impugned judgment and order on two fold arguments. Firstly, the judgment and order under challenge is not an exparte decree. So the application under the Provisions of Order IX Rule 13 of the Code cannot be entertained. Secondly the learned judge without appreciating the materials on record and Provisions of law, allowed such application, causing serious miscarriage of justice. 

 12. Moreover, the impugned order in its entirety are not well founded on the facts and circumstances of the case. So the contentions advanced by the learned Counsel for the petitioners are correct exposition of law and facts. Therefore, the legal pleas taken by him prevails and appears to have a good deal of force. 

 13. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and foregoing narrative I am of the view that the impugned judgment and order suffers from legal infirmities which calls for interference by this Court. Thus the Rule having merit succeeds. 

 14. In the result, the Rule is made absolute without any order as to cost. Accordingly the impugned judgment and order of the Court below is set aside. Misc. Case no. 40 of 1998 is dismissed. The order of stay granted earlier stands vacated. 

 15. Office is directed to send down the records of the case at once with a copy of judgment for information and necessary action.
